primitives.name: As-of Feature Engineering
primitives.verbatim_quote: **cbratkovics/fantasy-football-ai** (MIT, 16★) — dbt bronze/silver/gold + as-of feature engineering + per-position RF/XGBoost with decision-policy tables.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time index (dimensionless)', 'X_{t}': 'feature vector at time t (dimensionless)', 'Y_{t}': 'outcome variable at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Features are temporally consistent and causally ordered; no future information leaks into training set.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t < T, where T is the latest known observation, otherwise undefined.

layer2.mapping: The as-of pattern maps to a temporal slice operator in GSE's rule store, ensuring that each rule evaluates under a fixed historical context.
layer2.telemetry: Rule accuracy under varying time slices.

primitives.name: Weak Signal Registry
primitives.verbatim_quote: **ryanpmcintire/nfl_py3** (MIT, 15★) — Bayesian team model, market-updated model, leader-median confidence, agentless experiment pipeline (declarative spec → reliability check → bootstrap → registry).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_i': 'signal strength of rule i (dimensionless)', 'C_i': 'confidence of rule i (dimensionless)', 'R_i': 'rule identifier (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Signal strength is independent across rules; confidence is calibrated via bootstrap sampling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_i < threshold, rule is registered in weak signal pool.

layer2.mapping: Registry acts as a kernel embedding of rule-space in GSE’s rule store, enabling compositional logic over weak signals.
layer2.telemetry: Number of active weak signals per season.

primitives.name: Monte Carlo Correlation Pricing
primitives.verbatim_quote: **chmoses98/nfl-edge-finder** (no license — method only) — Monte Carlo game/period/player engines with common random numbers; joint engine prices composites on the SAME draws, never multiplying marginals; market reconciliation weights.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Z': 'joint probability draw (dimensionless)', 'W': 'market weight (dimensionless)', 'P(Z|W)': 'conditional price under market weights (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Common random numbers ensure correlation consistency; marginal multiplication introduces error.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Z is sampled from shared distribution, otherwise invalid.

layer2.mapping: Correlation layer in DFS sim mirrors joint engine structure, enabling accurate parlay valuation without independence assumption.
layer2.telemetry: Parlay variance reduction compared to marginal pricing.
